authTermsIntro: Read the entire document before accepting. Your acceptance will be linked to your account.
authTerms1Body: Guardian Escolar supports student tracking, guardian management, routes, safe zones, alerts, and emergency contacts. It does not replace responsible supervision by parents, guardians, or schools.
authTerms2Body: When tracking features are used, the guardian authorizes processing the linked student's device location. This data displays trips and detects safe-zone exits, possible route deviations, and inactivity.
authTerms3Body: Users must provide accurate information, secure their account, ensure location permissions are enabled on the student's device, and share access only with authorized people.
authTerms4Body: The service processes names, email addresses, phone numbers, student details, emergency contacts, notification settings, routes, safe zones, and reported locations to operate the system. This information must not be shared with unauthorized third parties.
authTerms5Body: The system may send email, push alerts, or SMS when enabled. Delivery depends on external services, internet access, device permissions, and provider availability.
authTerms6Body: Users are responsible for protecting their password and signing out on shared devices. Guardian Escolar may block actions or request email verification to reduce unauthorized access.
authTerms7Body: Location accuracy may vary due to GPS, mobile networks, Wi-Fi, battery, operating-system permissions, or surroundings. Alerts are preventive aids and may be delayed.
authTerms8Body: By creating an account, the user confirms they have read and accept these Terms and the Guardian Escolar Privacy Policy. Version {version}.
